scope: Native clipAlphaRect semantics mapped to a reusable engine image effect, with existing Canvas image preparation for composed inputs

reference.inspection: Complete Main.cpp, manual, readme and build manifest inspected. Secondary Rust implementations were read as navigation aids, not embedded or used as the engine boundary.

semantics.arguments: Seven mandatory values; coordinates and optional clear use signed32 coercion. Source width/height must be positive; clear applies only when0..255 and not void.
semantics.coverage: Source/destination image bounds and destination clip bound the operation; source clip does not. Alpha product is (p+(p>>7))>>8 for p=da*sa. Normal profile retains hidden RGB.
semantics.associated: ltAddAlpha profile scales all four stored bytes by source coverage with the same rounding. With clear, exterior RGBA is scaled; entirely disjoint source uses the original special coverage-only clear policy.
semantics.alias: Original source pointers may alias destination; forward writes, including exterior clearing, can affect later source samples. The public self_source option explicitly preserves this.
semantics.publication: Native policy captures only its own Canvas when no immutable CPU source graph is available, then calls the shared ImageInput::Raster/ImageEffect::AlphaClipRect pipeline and existing immutable resource publication. No native pixel loop or framebuffer.

shared_api: crysirror_image::alpha_clip::AlphaClipRect::validate/apply; ImageEffect::AlphaClipRect; public Bitmap.beginAlphaClip(slot,source,options) with existing worker tickets and client/epoch/revision checks.
limits: This adds clipAlphaRect, not every layerExBTOA helper or a new renderer blend model. Unknown methods remain visible failures. Native callbacks require a resumable boundary; presenter-less composed capture fails explicitly. No original EXE/DLL executed.
